hooks.command: $raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $d=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json; $f=$d.tool_input.file_path; if($f -match 'settings\.json'){ $s=Get-Content $f -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; $issues=@(); foreach($event in $s.hooks.PSObject.Properties){ foreach($group in $event.Value){ foreach($hook in $group.hooks){ $desc=if($group.matcher){"$($event.Name)[$($group.matcher)]"}else{$event.Name}; if(-not $hook.statusMessage){$issues+="$desc missing statusMessage"}; if($hook.command -notmatch 'systemMessage'){$issues+="$desc missing systemMessage in output"} } } }; if($issues.Count -gt 0){ $msg="Hook validation failed — "+($issues -join "; "); $out=[PSCustomObject]@{systemMessage=$msg;hookSpecificOutput=[PSCustomObject]@{hookEventName="PostToolUse";additionalContext="Fix these hooks: "+($issues -join ", ")}}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out } }

$raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $d=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json; $f=$d.tool_input.file_path; $ext=if($f){[IO.Path]::GetExtension($f).ToLower()}else{''}; $skip=@('.md','.json','.txt','.xml','.yaml','.yml','.toml','.ini','.cfg','.gitignore','.editorconfig',''); if($f -and $skip -notcontains $ext){ Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"Code file modified — run tests before finishing (build_dotnet_app / run_ahk_tests).","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Code file modified. Before finishing: run automated tests (build_dotnet_app for .NET/.cs changes, run_ahk_tests for .ahk changes). If UI or visual rendering changed, also run screenshot tests via the render test infrastructure (RenderHelper)."}}'  }

$raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $d=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json; $f=$d.tool_input.file_path; if($f){ git ls-files --error-unmatch $f 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ git check-ignore -q $f 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"New untracked file — consider updating .gitignore.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"New untracked file created. Ask the user whether it should be added to .gitignore."}}' } } }

if ((Test-Path '.agents/skills') -and -not (Test-Path '.claude/skills')) { if (-not (Test-Path '.claude')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '.claude' | Out-Null }; New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path '.claude/skills' -Target (Resolve-Path '.agents/skills') | Out-Null; Write-Output '{"systemMessage":"Skills directory symlinked from .agents/skills."}' }
